gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-georgian: Noto Sans Georgian keeps its curves open and its ascenders short. Expose is the louder one, packing caps and lowercase tight into a compressed, striking line, while the body font simply stays modern and easy to follow.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-glagolitic: Capitals that barely rise above the lowercase give Expose a compressed, refined punch, with hardly a pause between letters. Noto Sans Glagolitic handles the quiet work, with sturdy round shapes that stay clear in small sizes.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-gothic: Noto Sans Gothic has big, glassy counters and rounded forms. Beneath the tight, striking Expose heading, a longer passage would move along smoothly, with the plain sans text giving every line plenty of breathing space.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-grantha: Expose squeezes its caps and lowercase into a tight, refined line, hardly pausing between letters. Noto Sans Grantha follows with tall, compact letters that never clog, so the text beneath stays open; give the heading the bigger size.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-gujarati: Almost no step separates the capitals from the lowercase in Expose, which gives its heading a tight, striking rhythm. But Noto Sans Gujarati is the one built for steady reading, with curved strokes that stop short and wide counters.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-gunjala-gondi: Noto Sans Gunjala Gondi reads tall and modern, with cut-back terminals. Make Expose small and its compressed, striking cadence gets lost, while the body font at large sizes would lose its sense of purpose.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-gurmukhi: Tight, striking and refined, that is Expose in a line. It excels at compressed display impact, and Noto Sans Gurmukhi takes over with outward-pointing terminals and low ascenders that make the smaller text feel clean.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-hanunoo: Expose barely lets its capitals rise above the lowercase, which gives the heading a compressed, refined punch. Noto Sans Hanunoo does the opposite job, filling most of the line height with open terminals that are easy to follow.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-hebrew: Noto Sans Hebrew has a big midsection and wide gaps at its curves. Under a tight, striking Expose heading, a longer passage would feel spacious and modern, with the plain sans lines moving easily.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-imperial-aram: Expose compresses its caps and lowercase into a refined, striking line with hardly a pause. Noto Sans Imperial Aramaic offers a gentler job, its c ends pointing apart and its capitals standing just a short step above the lowercase.
